scope: in-process synthetic software model for draft ADR 0005
checks: Two distinct encryption/signing identities under the same immutable account
Both devices open one encrypted synthetic collection
Retained device opens fresh epoch after removal; retired device fails
Retired private key fails new recipient package even bypassing roster policy checks
Historical ciphertext and packages remain readable at the old pin
Signing and both encryption keys require proof of possession
Wrong fingerprints, substituted keys, forged proofs and signatures rejected
Expired/replayed/concurrent enrollment and stale revocation rejected without state changes
Retained separate authority can enroll after every ordinary device is removed
Rollback, conflicting parent, forged roster and wrong collection/epoch rejected
Ciphertext, wrapper, signature and delivery-profile tampering rejected
Existing independent X-Wing adapter vectors pass
hardware: not used by this model; separate Touch ID evidence exists
recovery_limit: Re-enrollment via retained authority is tested; lost collection-secret recovery is not implemented by this model
remaining: Independent protocol review and frozen canonical wire formats
Production account/device APIs, group permissions and atomic journal/CAS integration
Recovery custody and complete device lifecycle validation
